fact: ABLOGUI recorded restrictions on Facebook, TikTok and YouTube in Guinea from 27 July 2026, lifted by 15 August 2026 after at least 20 days, with no official explanation from the regulator or government.
title: Communiqué N°003/BE/ABLOGUI/2026 relative à la levée des perturbations du réseau internet observées depuis le 27 juillet
